verify.subject: Confirm your e-mail address — Konkouré
verify.body: Confirm your e-mail address to activate your Konkouré account. This link is valid for 24 hours.

reset.subject: Reset your password — Konkouré
reset.body: A password reset was requested for your account. This link is valid for 1 hour and can be used once. If you did not request it, ignore this e-mail.

sessionCompromised.subject: Security alert on your account — Konkouré
sessionCompromised.body: One of your account sessions was reused in a suspicious way and has been closed as a precaution. If you do not recognize this activity, change your password.

invitation.subject: Invitation to join {organization} on Konkouré
invitation.body: {inviter} invites you to join {organization} on Konkouré as "{role}". This link is valid for 7 days.

leaveRequested.subject: {employee} requests {type}
leaveRequested.body: {employee} requests {type} from {start} to {end}, {days} day(s). The request awaits your decision in Konkouré.

approved.subject: Your {type} is approved
approved.body: Your {type} request from {start} to {end} ({days} day(s)) has been approved.

rejected.subject: Your {type} is declined
rejected.body: Your {type} request from {start} to {end} ({days} day(s)) has been declined.

contractExpiring.subject: Contract ending soon: {employee}
contractExpiring.body: The contract of {employee} ends on {end}. Remember to renew it or to prepare the end of employment.

employeesExport.subject: Your employee export is ready — Konkouré
employeesExport.body: The export of {rows} employee(s) is ready. The download link is valid for 24 hours.

timeLogsExport.subject: Your punch export is ready — Konkouré
timeLogsExport.body: The export of {rows} punch(es) is ready. The download link is valid for 24 hours.

reviewOpened.subject: Your "{cycle}" evaluation is open
reviewOpened.body: Your evaluation for the "{cycle}" cycle is open. You can start your self-evaluation.

reviewSentBack.subject: Your "{cycle}" evaluation was sent back
reviewSentBack.body: Your manager sent back your evaluation for the "{cycle}" cycle for correction.
